title: قواعد تشخیص فاز پرواز EP-DOA
description: این قواعد فاز هر ثانیهٔ پرواز (تاکسی، شروع برخاست، برخاست، صعود، کروز، پرواز هم‌تراز، نزول، فرود و تاکسی پس از فرود) را از کانال‌های ثبت‌شده تشخیص می‌دهند. منطق آن‌ها همان الگوریتم مرجع پک ECTM v3.3 است و روی ۸ پرواز مرجع و ۱۰۲ پرواز واقعی با آن برابر است. سامانه هر نسخه را خودش با مرجع مقایسه می‌کند و هر تغییری نسبت به مرجع را نشان می‌دهد. آستانه‌ها پیشنهادی‌اند و هنوز کالیبره نشده‌اند و مهندس پرواز هم آن‌ها را تأیید نکرده است. دلیل هر انتخاب در بخش decisions آمده است.
source: pack v3.3 reference/ectm_oracle.py phase() (phase-v1.0.3; reproduces fixtures/golden 8/8) with the values of contracts/policy-defaults-v1.json -> phase (policy v1-calibration-candidate); measured on all 102 real files of samples/ (stage/P05 GAP-ANALYSIS); every departure from contracts/phase-ruleset-runtime-v1.json is a decision below

events.note: Deployed on 0.4 % of all samples of samples/ per engine, in all 102 flights
Engaged on 2.5 % of all samples of samples/, in all 102 flights
Disconnect on 0.1 % of all samples of samples/, in 100 of 102 flights
Warning on 0.8 % of all samples of samples/, in all 102 flights
Warning on 50.4 % of all samples of samples/ (all 102 flights); the meaning of the literal is unverified, so the channel is not evaluated
Cutoff in 6 flights on engine 1 and 7 flights on engine 2 of samples/
Only 'No Fire' is recorded in samples/; the active literal is unknown until the recorder documentation names it

Only 'No Shake' is recorded in samples/; the active literal is unknown until the recorder documentation names it

decisions.choice: Express the pack oracle phase() of phase-v1.0.3 exactly
decisions.basis: It reproduces the 8 goldens; the pack runtime AST is a candidate whose equivalence is unverified (docs/28 section 1) and differs from the goldens in the points of P05-D02 to P05-D08
decisions.howToChange: Edit the parts named in P05-D02 to P05-D08 in a draft, dry-run it on flights, then publish

decisions.choice: The FIRST AIR to GND change of the discrete that holds 5 s, after lift-off
decisions.basis: The goldens use it; on all 102 real files there is exactly one such change, so FIRST and LAST give the same sample
decisions.alternative: LAST, as in docs/04 section 3 and the pack AST
decisions.howToChange: Set anchors TOUCHDOWN pick to LAST

decisions.choice: Ground needs AIR_GROUND = GND and a valid smoothed rate (nullAllowed false)
decisions.alternative: The pack AST: no discrete test and a missing rate allowed
decisions.howToChange: Remove the EQUALS AIR_GROUND test or set nullAllowed to true in conditions GROUND

decisions.choice: The speed tests count only while AIR_GROUND = AIR; radio height above 50 ft with CAS of 90 kt or more counts on its own
decisions.alternative: The pack AST: the speed tests without the discrete
decisions.howToChange: Edit the predicate of conditions AIRBORNE

decisions.choice: Walk back from lift-off while GS is 40 kt or more, radio height is 50 ft or less and the sample is not ground, for at most 120 s
decisions.alternative: The pack AST: from the last GS below 40 kt to lift-off
decisions.howToChange: Edit the while predicate or lookbackSec of conditions TAKEOFF_ROLL

decisions.choice: Lift-off to 120 s after it, excluding ground samples
decisions.alternative: The pack AST: the whole window
decisions.howToChange: Remove the where predicate of conditions TAKEOFF

decisions.choice: A landing roll is claimed only when GS is 80 kt or more at touchdown; no fallback
decisions.basis: The goldens use it; in 9 of 102 real flights the discrete reaches GND only at GS 18 to 37 kt, so no landing roll is claimed there
decisions.alternative: A fallback touchdown from radio height or deceleration, which needs the flight engineer
decisions.howToChange: Lower startWhen of conditions LANDING_ROLL, or add a fallback anchor after the engineer's review

decisions.choice: The lift-off fallback PARTIAL_START uses the quality result (radio height above 20 ft at the first sample)
decisions.basis: The goldens use it; 20 of 102 real files start airborne
decisions.alternative: The pack AST: AIR_GROUND = AIR or radio height above 20 ft
decisions.howToChange: Change partial.startRadioHeightAboveFt in QUALITY_RULES, or remove PARTIAL_START from the lift-off fallbackBases

decisions.choice: Every number is the value of policy-defaults-v1.json -> phase; minValid 3 is the oracle's fixed value
decisions.basis: Pack values, CANDIDATE until calibration in P13 on an independent corpus
decisions.alternative: Values proposed by the flight engineer
decisions.howToChange: Edit the number in a draft and compare with the dry-run before publishing

decisions.choice: No groundspeed plausibility gate; such samples stay UNKNOWN
decisions.basis: In 2026-10-05_EP-DOA_14200 GS reads 335 to 365 kt on the ground for 868 s, so 18.6 % of the flight is UNKNOWN; claiming a phase there would be invented
decisions.alternative: A plausibility test on GS against CAS on the ground, after the engineer's review
decisions.howToChange: Add a predicate to conditions GROUND

decisions.choice: Spans of the observed active literals; fire and stick shaker are not evaluated because only their inactive literal is recorded; the left A/T warning is not evaluated; AT_ENGAGED is a state, not an event
decisions.basis: Literal shares measured on all 102 real files of samples/ (the note of each event)
decisions.alternative: Enable a channel once the recorder documentation names its active literal and meaning
decisions.howToChange: Set enabled and activeValue of the event

decisions.choice: The oracle's evidence codes, which quote the default thresholds
decisions.howToChange: Edit segments evidenceCodes together with the threshold they quote

decisions.alternative: APPROVED after the flight engineer's review
decisions.howToChange: Set engineeringSignOff in a new version with the reviewer's approval note
